name: LangChain
product: LangChain provides open-source agent frameworks and the LangSmith platform for building and operating agents.
opportunity: Turn recurring onboarding and support friction into evaluated, reviewable agent workflows.
hypothesis: Repeated implementation questions can reveal both a support opportunity and an adoption barrier. A scoped agent with evaluations and a human escalation path could help teams resolve them more consistently.
automations: Retrieve relevant documentation and include sources in a draft answer.
Evaluate groundedness on a small reviewed set before release.
Escalate uncertain responses and feed failures back into the evaluation set.
roadmap: Review common onboarding questions and define a human baseline.
Build a narrow retrieval and evaluation pilot with an explicit escalation path.
Measure resolution quality and adoption; add coverage only after review.
fit: CJ built a source-backed extraction pipeline with validation and bounded retries, and has evaluated AI models for source grounding and extraction cost.
